key.name: enable-schedule
key.description: Whether grayscale should turn on and off automatically at the configured times

key.name: start-hour
key.description: Hour at which grayscale turns on automatically

key.name: end-hour
key.description: Hour at which grayscale turns off automatically

key.name: start-minute
key.description: Minute at which grayscale turns on automatically

key.name: end-minute
key.description: Minute at which grayscale turns off automatically

key.name: strength
key.description: How strong the grayscale effect is, where 100 is full grayscale and 0 has no effect
